description.text: Core courses Math Analysis, Advanced Algebra, Analytic Geometry, Ordinary Differential Equation, Complex Analysis, Modern Algebra, Operations Research, Statistics and Probability, Basic Theoretical Computer Science, Numerical Computation Methods, C Programming Language, Data Structure, Fundamentals of Software System, Foundations of Information Science, Computer Graphics, Basic Sociology. Objective This objective is to train students to obtain solid math knowledge, and the basic theories and methods of information and computation so that students, after graduation, will become high-qualified professional personnel who can operate computer and other modern facilities for scientific computation, applied software development, system maintenance, and information analysis and control as well as being engaged in scientific planning and management in technology sectors. Students after graduation can continue to study math or related specialties at graduate level or work in science and technology units, education sections, enterprises or institutions to pursuit research, teaching, application development or management in respect of information science and computation. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Science is granted.

duration.text: The Information and Computing Science at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
